name: f4-curv-depth-kpi-compare-model
description: Pairs the real GDX_HNF_CDI_VALUE (CDIx, written by F4_CURV_DEPTH_KPI_ORIG_CHARACTERISTICS) and GDX_HNF_CDIH_VALUE (CDIh, written by F4_CURV_DEPTH_KPI_LATENT_SPACE) rows for one chosen CDI run and one chosen CDIh run of the same study, by ID_PERSON, and freezes the result into GDX_HNF_CDI_COMPARE_RUN / GDX_HNF_CDI_COMPARE_VALUE. Never computes CDIx or CDIh itself, never computes a derived statistic (Pearson r, rank) -- that is this skill's GRAPH sibling's job at render time.
